name: AK Turnip 1.14
description: AK Turnip 1.14: correctness release on top of 1.13, no compiler or rendering changes. Descriptor-load speculation check for variable-count bindings fixed (the variable binding could be read past the end of the set, while all other bindings in such layouts lost preamble hoisting; hits vkd3d-proton bindless layouts); sampler creation fails cleanly instead of writing out of bounds when all 4096 custom border colors are used; descriptor pools no longer leak host memory on OUT_OF_POOL_MEMORY; back-to-back vkCmdInsertDebugUtilsLabelEXT no longer grows the label stack (Vulkan runtime bug); merged queue submits keep the binary-semaphore wait flag of both submits; no longer advertises format features the driver cannot honour (MSAA for FDM/FSR usage, buffer support for compressed formats, sparse residency without device support, TRANSFER bits in bufferFeatures); device-creation failure paths fixed (mutex leaks, teardown order); lazy MSRTSS allocation only when supported; a630 CP_DRAW_AUTO stale vertex stride workaround; invalid FD_RD_DUMP_PATH no longer hangs. Built with platform-sdk-version=33.
author: aydar
